sections.title: Referencia
sections.lede: <is-carousel> + <is-carousel-item> — Web Components (vanilla, zero dependencies). Carrusel tipo slides con paginación, autoplay, loop, navegación prev/next, indicadores y soporte para swipe en touch. <is-carousel autoplay loop> <is-carousel-item>…</is-carousel-item> <is-carousel-item>…</is-carousel-item> <is-carousel-item>…</is-carousel-item> </is-carousel> Atributos <is-carousel> active             number (0-indexed) loop               boolean                  (default false) autoplay           number (ms)              (default 0 — desactivado) without-controls   boolean                  (oculta prev/next) without-indicators boolean                  (oculta indicators) vertical           boolean                  (slides verticales) slides-per-page    number                   (default 1) aspect-ratio       string                   (CSS, e.g. "16/9") Atributos <is-carousel-item> label              string (accesibilidad) disabled           boolean Slots <is-carousel> (default)    items. prev-icon    override del icono prev. next-icon    override del icono next. <is-carousel-item> (default)   contenido del slide. Eventos is-carousel-change detail: { from, to, item } is-carousel-pause  detail: { reason: 'user' | 'auto' | 'visibility' } is-carousel-play   detail: {} is-carousel-slide-end (cuando termina swipe) CSS Parts is-carousel: ::part(base) ::part(viewport) ::part(track) ::part(indicators) ::part(controls) is-carousel-item: ::part(base)
